title: Calix | Planeswalker
description: Learn more about the Planeswalker Calix, from Magic: The Gathering.

paragraphs.text: Calix was artificially created by the God of Destiny on the plane of Theros to prevent Elspeth Tirel from escaping the Underworld. When Calix failed in his duty, his fated purpose ignited his Spark, allowing him to pursue Elspeth across the multiverse.
